entries.name: Thumbnail — Disabled
entries.description: Thumbnails in the disabled state with reduced opacity. The remove button and click handler are suppressed when disabled.

entries.name: Thumbnail — Gallery
entries.description: A row of clickable thumbnails with labels that open a detail view. Use for image attachment lists where users need to preview and manage uploads.

entries.name: Thumbnail — Removable
entries.description: Thumbnails with a remove button overlay. The close button uses APCA luminance detection to stay visible on both dark and light images.

entries.name: Thumbnail
entries.description: A thumbnail with an image and label.

entries.name: Thumbnail — States
entries.description: All visual states side by side: image loaded, placeholder, skeleton loading, and upload overlay. Demonstrates the full lifecycle of a thumbnail from empty to loaded.

entries.name: TimeInput — Constrained
entries.description: Time inputs with min/max constraints limiting selection to specific windows. Use to prevent out-of-bounds selections for appointments, reservations, or shift scheduling.

entries.name: TimeInput — Formats
entries.description: 12-hour, 24-hour, and seconds formats side by side. Use 12h for US-centric UIs, 24h for international or technical contexts, and seconds for precise timing.

entries.name: TimeInput — Increment
entries.description: Time input with a custom step increment. Arrow keys jump by the specified interval (e.g. 15 minutes) for quick slot-based scheduling.

entries.name: Time Input
entries.description: A time input that uses the browser/OS picker on touch by default and Astryx typed entry on fine pointers.

entries.name: TimeInput — States
entries.description: Default, disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use status messages to give users clear feedback about their time selection.

entries.name: Timestamp — Auto
entries.description: Auto format that shows relative time for recent dates and switches to the full date for older ones. The default choice for most use cases.

entries.name: Timestamp — Colors
entries.description: Timestamp rendered in each available color variant: primary, secondary, disabled, and active.

entries.name: Timestamp — Formats
entries.description: All display formats side by side: date, date_time, time, and their system equivalents. Use date and date_time for user-facing UI, system variants for logs and dev tools.

entries.name: Timestamp — Relative
entries.description: Relative time labels from seconds to months ago, with hover tooltips showing the full date. Use in feeds, comment threads, and activity logs.

entries.name: Timestamp — Timezone
entries.description: Timestamps with the timezone abbreviation appended. Enable isTimezoneShown for audiences across time zones, like audit logs or team calendars.

entries.name: Timestamp — Tooltip time zones
entries.description: Hover tooltips that show one instant across several time zones or formats. Use tooltipEntries when readers must compare zones, like an incident log carrying both the reader's time and the event's origin zone.

entries.name: Toast — Action
entries.description: Persistent toasts with a trailing button or link so the user can act on the notification, like undoing a delete or viewing a report.

entries.name: Toast — Deduplication
entries.description: Prevent duplicate toasts with uniqueID. Use ignore to keep the first toast, or overwrite to replace it with updated content like a progress percentage.

entries.name: Toast — Dismiss
entries.description: Show a persistent toast and dismiss it programmatically using the function returned by useToast. Use for long-running operations that need manual cleanup.

entries.name: Toast
entries.description: Imperative toast notifications triggered with useToast and rendered in the toast viewport.

entries.name: Toast — Stacking
entries.description: Multiple toasts stacking vertically with smooth enter and exit animations. Click repeatedly to see how toasts queue and dismiss.

entries.name: Toast — Types
entries.description: Info and error toast variants side by side. Info toasts auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, error toasts persist until the user dismisses them.

entries.name: ToggleButton — Color
entries.description: Toggle buttons with colored icons in the pressed state. Shows accent-colored toolbar formatting and semantic reaction colors (yellow star, red heart, blue bookmark).

entries.name: ToggleButton — Group
entries.description: Toggle button groups in single-select and multi-select modes. Single selection acts as a view mode switcher; multiple selection forms a formatting toolbar.

entries.name: Toggle Button Group
entries.description: ToggleButtonGroup manages a set of ToggleButtons with single-select or multi-select behavior for options like view modes or filters.

entries.name: ToggleButtonGroup — Vertical
entries.description: A vertically stacked ToggleButtonGroup using the vertical orientation, shown with both single-select and multi-select behavior, ideal for sidebar-style option lists and vertical toolbars.

entries.name: ToggleButton — Icon Swap
entries.description: Icon-only toggle buttons that swap between outline and solid icons when pressed. Use for actions like favorite, bookmark, or mute where the icon itself communicates the state.

entries.name: ToggleButton — Label
entries.description: Toggle buttons with visible text labels that show a font weight shift on press. Use when the icon alone is not enough to communicate the action.

entries.name: ToggleButton — States
entries.description: Default, pressed, disabled, and loading states of a standalone toggle button. Shows how visual treatment changes across states.

entries.name: Token — Clickable
entries.description: Interactive tokens that respond to clicks. Use for toggleable filters or tokens that open a detail view when selected.

entries.name: Token — Colors
entries.description: All 11 color variants in default and disabled states. Use color to categorize entities or convey status at a glance.

entries.name: Token — End Content
entries.description: Tokens with trailing content like a count badge or status indicator after the label. Use for notification counts, item quantities, or compact status info.

entries.name: Token — Icon
entries.description: Tokens with a leading icon that identifies the entity type. Use when the icon helps users recognize the token category faster, like a user icon for people or a tag icon for labels.

entries.name: Tokenizer — Clear
entries.description: Tokenizer with a built-in clear-all button for bulk removal of all selected tokens.

entries.name: Tokenizer — Creatable
entries.description: Free-text tokenizer for creating custom tags and a combined create-or-search pattern. Use when users need to enter values that may not exist in a predefined list.

entries.name: Tokenizer — End Content
entries.description: Tokenizer with an action button in the end slot. Use for inline actions like applying selections alongside the input.

entries.name: Tokenizer — Icon
entries.description: Tokenizer with a leading search icon to visually reinforce the search behavior.

entries.name: Tokenizer — Max Entries
entries.description: Tokenizer with a maximum selection limit. The input hides automatically when the limit is reached, preventing further additions.

entries.name: Tokenizer — Overflow
entries.description: Tokenizer with overflow truncation when unfocused. Inline mode pushes content down on expand; layer mode overlays without shifting layout.

entries.name: Tokenizer
entries.description: A tokenizer with preset tags and search source.

entries.name: Tokenizer — States
entries.description: Tokenizer in disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use to communicate validation feedback or lock a selection from editing.

entries.name: Token — Removable
entries.description: Tokens with a dismiss button for selections the user can undo. Use in multi-select fields, active filters, or any list of user-chosen items.

entries.name: Toolbar — Bulk Actions
entries.description: A compact toolbar with the muted variant for showing bulk selection actions. Use when the user selects multiple items in a list or table and needs quick access to batch operations.

entries.name: Toolbar — Card Header
entries.description: A toolbar as a card header with a left-aligned title and icon actions on the right. Use Toolbar instead of LayoutHeader when your card header has interactive actions; Toolbar adds start/end slot layout, keyboard navigation, and automatic size cascading. If the header is just a title with no actions, a LayoutHeader or Section is enough.

entries.name: Toolbar — Sizes
entries.description: Small, medium, and large toolbars side by side. The size prop cascades to child buttons and inputs automatically. Use small in dense UIs like cards, medium for most cases, and large for spacious layouts.

entries.name: Toolbar — Table Filter
entries.description: A compact toolbar with a search input, Status and Priority filter selectors, and an overflow menu. Use above a data table to let users search, filter, and access view options.

entries.name: Toolbar — Three Slot
entries.description: A toolbar with start, center, and end content using the three-column grid layout. Use when you need a centered title or heading with navigation and actions on either side.

entries.name: Toolbar — Tab Navigation
entries.description: A toolbar with tabs in the start slot and an action button at the end. Use as a card or section header when content is split into tabs with a primary action alongside.

entries.name: Tooltip — Action Bar
entries.description: Tooltips on an action button bar with contextual descriptions.

entries.name: Tooltip — Hook Usage
entries.description: Tooltip using the useTooltip hook for programmatic control.

entries.name: Tooltip — Inline Text
entries.description: Tooltips on inline text terms for definitions.

entries.name: TopNav — Centered Navigation
entries.description: Navigation layout with center-aligned nav items flanked by a logo heading and end actions.

entries.name: TopNav — Enterprise Dashboard
entries.description: Full-featured navigation bar with icon-labeled nav items, search, notifications, and a primary CTA.

entries.name: TopNavHeading — Basic
entries.description: A product heading with a logo inside a TopNav, linked to the home page. Use as the leading brand element of a top navigation bar.

entries.name: Top Nav Heading
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavHeading with a logo and text, both as a plain display and as a clickable link.

entries.name: TopNav — Hover Menu
entries.description: Navigation bar with a hover-triggered dropdown menu showing product items with icons and descriptions.

entries.name: TopNavItem — Basic
entries.description: Navigation links inside a TopNav with one item marked as selected. Use for top-level pages of an application.

entries.name: Top Nav Item
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavItem with selected, icon, disabled, and default states.

entries.name: TopNav — Mega Menu
entries.description: Marketing-style navigation with a full-width mega menu featuring product items and a promotional featured card.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenu — Basic
entries.description: A mega menu trigger inside a TopNav that opens a panel of rich link items. Use when a navigation section has multiple destinations worth describing.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard — Basic
entries.description: A promotional card with a title, description, and call-to-action link. Pass it to the featured slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to highlight announcements.

entries.name: Top Nav Mega Menu Featured Card
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard with a title, description, and CTA link inside a mega menu.

entries.name: TopNavMegaMenuItem — Basic
entries.description: Rich link items with an icon, title, and description. Use inside the items slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to describe each destination.

entries.name: Top Nav Mega Menu Item
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuItem with icons, titles, and descriptions inside a mega menu.

entries.name: Top Nav Mega Menu
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenu with items and a featured card in the mega menu panel.

entries.name: TopNavMenu — Basic
entries.description: A dropdown menu inside a TopNav built from an items array with icons and descriptions. Use to group related destinations under a single trigger.

entries.name: Top Nav Menu
entries.description: Demonstrates TopNavMenu with a hover-triggered dropdown containing items with icons and descriptions.

entries.name: TopNav — Multiple Dropdowns
entries.description: Navigation bar with multiple hover-triggered dropdown menus that auto-close when switching between them.

entries.name: TopNav — With Logo
entries.description: Navigation bar with a branded logo icon, heading link, nav items, and a profile action.

entries.name: TreeList — File Tree With Icons
entries.description: File browser tree with folder and document icons distinguishing directories from files.

entries.name: TreeList — Interactive Settings
entries.description: Settings tree with clickable items and a documentation link.

entries.name: TreeList — Mailbox Tree
entries.description: Email folder tree with unread badge counts.

entries.name: TreeList — Navigation Tree
entries.description: Navigation tree with a selected item for the current page.

entries.name: Tree List — Variants
entries.description: The `variant` prop controls whether hierarchy guide lines are shown: `lineGuides` (default) draws connector lines between parent and child rows, while `noGuides` relies on indentation alone. It is orthogonal to `density`, which controls spacing.

entries.name: TypeaheadItem — Basic
entries.description: A typeahead whose results are rendered with TypeaheadItem, adding a secondary description below each label. Use inside renderItem to keep custom results visually consistent.

entries.name: Typeahead Item
entries.description: Typeahead with custom item rendering using TypeaheadItem for avatars and descriptions.

entries.name: Typeahead — Limited Results
entries.description: Typeahead with a capped dropdown showing at most three results.

entries.name: Typeahead — Search Field
entries.description: Search input with icon and suggestions on focus.

entries.name: Typeahead — With Helper Text
entries.description: Typeahead with a description below the label.

entries.name: Typeahead — With Validation
entries.description: Typeahead with an error validation message.

entries.name: useContainerReveal — Reveal-on-hover Row Actions
entries.description: File rows keep their edit/delete actions hidden at rest and reveal them on hover or keyboard focus via useContainerReveal; the actions stay mounted and in the tab order.

entries.name: useKeyboardHint — Arrow-key Hint
entries.description: Toolbar shows an ephemeral "← → to navigate" hint on first keyboard focus via useKeyboardHint, teaching sighted keyboard users that arrows move within the group.

entries.name: useStreamingText — Streaming Response
entries.description: Smooth bursty generated text into a steady reveal with useStreamingText.

entries.name: useTheme — Token Values
entries.description: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.

entries.name: VisuallyHidden — Live Region
entries.description: A polite aria-live region announces visual-only state changes to assistive technology.

entries.name: VisuallyHidden — Structural Heading
entries.description: Give a visually implicit section an accessible name so screen-reader users can navigate to it.

entries.name: VisuallyHidden — Supplementary Context
entries.description: Add screen-reader-only context to terse visual data, like spelling out what a trend arrow means.

entries.name: VStack — Basic
entries.description: A heading and paragraphs stacked vertically with a consistent gap. Use VStack whenever siblings should flow top to bottom with even spacing.

entries.name: V Stack
entries.description: Demonstrates VStack arranging items vertically with different gaps.

entries.name: AI Chat Conversation
entries.description: Transcript of alternating turns carrying mixed rich content inline (markdown, code blocks, collapsible tool-call output) beside a resizable artifact panel that holds generated output while the stream keeps scrolling. Chat, conversation, assistant, messages, or copilot thread.

entries.name: AI Chat Landing
entries.description: Zero-state entry surface centered on a single composer with suggestion chips instead of history, sized for the moment before any content exists. The empty counterpart to a transcript. Chat, conversation, assistant, prompt, or messages launcher.

entries.name: Blank
entries.description: Bare scaffold: one heading slot, one empty content region, no navigation and no chrome. The starting point when every other layout imposes more structure than wanted. Blank, empty, stub, placeholder, or minimal scaffold.

entries.name: Canvas Editor
entries.description: Layered artboard workspace: document tabs over a layer rail, a fixed-size frame you zoom on a muted backdrop, and an inspector of position, type, and filter fields that retargets to the selected layer. Objects hold a coordinate rather than reflowing, so moving one never moves another. Design tool, artboard, poster, graphic, image, or slide editor.

entries.name: Centered Hero
entries.description: Symmetrical centered stack (headline, short blurb, paired call-to-action buttons) resting on one wide full-bleed picture, with nothing on either flank competing. Hero, banner, splash, landing image, or marketing masthead.

entries.name: Checkout Wizard
entries.description: Multi-step checkout, cart, order, and payment wizard with a running summary that recalculates as answers change. It adapts to its host width, renders the summary first on narrow surfaces, validates every forward path, and completes locally without sending payment.

entries.name: Classic Gallery
entries.description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place. Regular rhythm, unlike the variable-height masonry variant. Gallery, photos, images, pictures, or portfolio index.

entries.name: Contact Form
entries.description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit. No steps, no branching, no summary rail. Contact, lead capture, enquiry, survey, or intake form.

entries.name: Analytics Dashboard
entries.description: Three-band analytics: a row of headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all re-reading from one global filter bar. Breadth over depth, a summary surface rather than a drill-down. Dashboard, overview, metrics, stats, analytics, reporting, or insights.

entries.name: Service Monitoring Dashboard
entries.description: Always-on analytics with a triage rail: status-colored tiles with sparklines, multi-series time charts over a switchable window, and an independently scrolling alert column that folds into the content when narrow. Monitoring, uptime, health, latency, alerting, incidents, or observability.

entries.name: Funnel & Cohort Dashboard
entries.description: Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap. Conversion, drop-off, activation, churn, or retention reporting.

entries.name: Data Dashboard
entries.description: Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that each carry an inline sparkline and several period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns underneath. Every number is shown against another number. Dashboard, metrics, stats, analytics, trends, or reporting.

entries.name: Portfolio Dashboard
entries.description: Analytics for a value-over-time question: balance and change tiles above a stacked area chart of composition through time, closing on a ranked table of the largest contributors. Portfolio, holdings, positions, returns, allocation, investments, or performance reporting.

entries.name: Project Status Dashboard
entries.description: Status analytics mixing progress and time-axis shapes: a completion donut, a horizontal timeline of dated bars against a today marker, a per-owner table with progress and status, an at-risk list, and a burndown. Project, program, milestone, roadmap, launch, or delivery status.

entries.name: Executive Summary Dashboard
entries.description: Report-shaped analytics with a prose rail beside the charts: a scorecard of headline numbers with period deltas and status coloring, goal-attainment bars, a trend grid, and a written commentary column that folds beneath the content when narrow. Executive summary, business review, readout, or reporting.

entries.name: Order Detail
entries.description: Single-record detail in two columns: a summary header with status and actions, a repeating line-item list, a totals block that sums it, and a chronological activity timeline in the rail. The shape for any record holding children plus a history: a customer order with shipping, an invoice, a transaction, or a job.

entries.name: Documentation Catalog
entries.description: Reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards linking into sections, with no article content on the surface itself. Documentation, docs, guide, handbook, reference, or API index.

entries.name: Documentation Design
entries.description: Reference article alternating prose with live rendered examples: an interactive preview, a property table, paired do and don't comparisons, and copyable code blocks. Documentation, docs, guide, reference, usage, or API entry.

entries.name: Documentation Technical
entries.description: Reference article ordered as sequential numbered steps with code at each stage, plus callout cards for prerequisites and onward links. A linear walkthrough rather than a browsable reference. Getting started, install, setup, tutorial, quickstart, or onboarding guide.

entries.name: Page Editor
entries.description: Three-pane authoring workspace: a source palette on one flank, a live canvas in the middle, and an inspector that retargets to whatever is selected. Drag and drop to reorder, edit to see it render immediately. Builder, composer, drag and drop, page builder, or WYSIWYG editor.

entries.name: File Explorer
entries.description: Hierarchical browser that drills through nested levels as adjacent columns rather than replacing the list each time, with breadcrumb history, switchable list and grid density, and a metadata pane for the selected node. Files, folders, directory, tree, or Finder-style navigator.

entries.name: Two-column Form
entries.description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll. Flat, single submit, no steps. Contact, lead capture, intake, request, or enquiry form.

entries.name: Form Wizard
entries.description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields. Only the current step renders, unlike an accordion where each section expands into one long scrolling form. Each advance is validated, and a step left broken stays flagged to jump back to. Wizard, stepper, multi-step, onboarding, setup, signup, or guided flow.

entries.name: Dialog Wizard
entries.description: Step through a short flow in a dialog, overlay, or popup launched from the page underneath, which stays where it was. Compact step markers and a pinned action row inside a constrained width, rather than the full page a wizard usually gets. Best for two to four short steps — setup, invite, schedule, onboarding — where losing the context underneath would cost more than the flow is worth.

entries.name: Inline Wizard
entries.description: Accordion wizard stacking every step in one column: the active step expands in place while finished ones collapse to a single line carrying their result and a way back in. Steps that run themselves expand into a nested stepper that ticks check by check and halts the column where one fails. Best when later steps depend on what earlier ones decided.

entries.name: Vertical Wizard
entries.description: Multi-step wizard with the steps in a fixed left rail that stays visible while the form scrolls, plus a side panel whose guidance follows the focused field. Suits long or unequal steps carrying uploads, previews, and dense review metadata. As width tightens the guidance drops first, then the rail rotates into a horizontal stepper above the form.

entries.name: Gallery Hero
entries.description: Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set. Hero, banner, splash, landing image, masthead, or gallery intro.

entries.name: IDE
entries.description: Dense multi-pane workspace of resizable, collapsible regions: a hierarchy tree on one flank, tabbed documents in the middle, a docked drawer along the bottom, an inspector opposite. Drag a divider to resize or collapse any of them. Editor, IDE, workbench, terminal, or development environment.

entries.name: Incident Console
entries.description: Dense row queue with an inspector: severity-coded rows grouped by status, a saved-search filter bar, a segmented status control, and a resizable detail pane for the selected row. Rows, not cards, sized for scanning volume. Incident, alert, on-call, outage, ticket, or triage console.

entries.name: Kanban Board
entries.description: Horizontal lanes of draggable cards where the column itself is the status, so drag and drop between lanes is the state change. Fixed columns, variable-height cards. Kanban, board, swimlane, sprint, backlog, tasks, or pipeline.

entries.name: Card Grid
entries.description: Searchable, browsable card grid with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles organized by topic, narrowing in place, with no detail surface behind them. Catalog, index, directory, library, browse, or gallery of entries.

entries.name: Basic Login
entries.description: Minimal centered credential form on a plain ground: two fields and a submit, nothing competing for attention. The least-chrome entry surface. Login, sign in, signin, authentication, credentials, or account access.

entries.name: Login Card
entries.description: Credential form inside an elevated centered card, third-party provider buttons separated from the fields by a divider, secondary sign-up and legal links beneath. Login, sign in, signin, authentication, credentials, social, or account access.

entries.name: Login Split
entries.description: Credential form filling one half of a two-pane split, full-bleed media holding the other. Same fields as the card variant, but the layout carries brand imagery. Login, sign in, signin, authentication, credentials, or account access.

entries.name: Login SSO
entries.description: Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback. Two-stage rather than one form. Single sign-on, SSO, SAML, enterprise login, directory, or corporate authentication.

entries.name: Messaging Shell
entries.description: Four-column nested navigation narrowing left to right (team workspace, channel list, message stream, thread panel) where each column scopes the next. Dense rows, zero cards. Team messaging, chat, channels, threads, inbox, direct message, or conversation workspace.

entries.name: Mixed Gallery
entries.description: Masonry grid of variable-height tiles that pack against each other instead of cropping to a shared ratio, captioned per tile. Irregular rhythm, unlike the uniform gallery. Photos, images, pictures, portfolio, masonry, or media wall.

entries.name: Checkout Form
entries.description: Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total. Sections run contact, address, delivery choice, then card details. Checkout, payment, billing, cart, buyer, or purchase.

entries.name: Product Detail
entries.description: Single-item detail pairing a media gallery with a selection column: variant swatches, a quantity stepper, primary and secondary commit actions, and collapsible specification sections below. Product, listing, item, catalog entry, or storefront detail.

entries.name: Product Gallery
entries.description: Uniform card grid where every tile carries media, title, supporting line, and a price. Browse-to-select only, with no filtering and no detail surface. Products, catalog, storefront, shop, listings, or ecommerce grid.

entries.name: Settings Form
entries.description: Preferences as one continuously scrolling form, sections stacked in order with no navigation between them. The simplest settings shape: everything reachable by scrolling. Settings, preferences, configuration, options, or account.

entries.name: Settings Dialog
entries.description: Preferences inside a modal container with searchable section navigation, so configuration happens without leaving whatever is underneath. Grouped toggles, live preview of appearance choices, rebindable shortcuts. Settings, preferences, configuration, options, or modal dialog.

entries.name: Settings Panels
entries.description: Preferences split into nav-switched panels: a persistent section list swaps the pane beside it, and rows edit in place rather than opening a separate form. Settings, preferences, configuration, options, or account panels.

entries.name: Shell Nav
entries.description: Application frame combining both navigation axes: a top menu bar with command-palette search over a resizable hierarchy rail, wrapping placeholder content. For when one axis is not enough. Shell, chrome, layout frame, navigation, sidebar, or menu bar.

entries.name: Side Nav
entries.description: Application frame with a single collapsible, resizable left rail carrying grouped history and search, wrapping the main content. Vertical navigation only, no top bar. Shell, chrome, layout frame, sidebar, drawer, left rail, or navigation.

entries.name: Top Nav
entries.description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width. Shell, chrome, layout frame, header, menu, topbar, or navigation.

entries.name: Side Gallery
entries.description: Asymmetric split section: a copy column of headline, supporting text, and links held against a clustered image collage opposite. Deliberately off-balance, unlike the centered hero. Feature banner, split section, marketing, or gallery intro.

entries.name: Simple Table
entries.description: Flat row collection where columns sort, rows select into a bulk-action toolbar, and each row carries an overflow menu. Sortable but ungrouped, with no detail pane, the baseline shape. Table, list, rows, records, grid, spreadsheet, or roster.

entries.name: Filterable Table
entries.description: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane. Table, list, rows, records, grid, search, or filtered dataset.

entries.name: Grouped Table
entries.description: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse. Query filtering and a resizable inspector for the selected row. Table, list, rows, records, grid, or grouped dataset.

entries.name: Inbox Table
entries.description: Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize. Rows stack when the table narrows, not the window; threads read as collapsible messages; replying opens a composer that leaves the list live. Inbox, mail, email, conversations, thread, triage, reading pane, split pane, resize, collapse, compose, or notifications.

entries.name: Searchable Table
entries.description: Flat table of uniform rows under a block of record-level facts, narrowed three ways at once — a full-text search box, a scope toggle, and per-column popovers — with sortable and filterable columns, per-row hover detail, and totals derived from the visible rows that flag themselves as partial while a filter is on. The shape for one homogeneous list, not nested rows or groups with their own columns. Search, filter, sort, table, data table, flat rows, records, dataset, or totals.

entries.name: Theme Showcase
entries.description: Several unrelated product surfaces rendered together on one canvas so a token change can be judged across contexts at once. A comparison harness rather than a layout to ship. Theme, tokens, palette, typography, styling, or design system preview.

entries.name: Work Item Detail
entries.description: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail with assignee, dates, labels, and linked items. The shape for any tracked item with children, properties, and a comment history — a task, ticket, issue, story, bug, card, request, or work item.
